input.text: URGENT: ~45 people in distress in the Central Mediterranean, taking water, position N 34 16.292 E 011 56.538. We alerted the authorities.

notes: Canonical active distress with a printed coordinate.

input.text: A boat capsized off Libya during the night. Survivors report many people fell into the water; several are missing.

notes: Capsize / people in water = shipwreck, not a clean distress.

input.text: We lost contact with a boat of 30 people that left Zuwara two days ago. No one has heard from them since.
The so-called Libyan coast guard intercepted the boat of ~50 people and returned them to Tripoli.
Testimonies describe a violent pushback in the Aegean: people forced back into a life raft and left adrift towards Turkey.
A pregnant woman on the boat needs urgent medical evacuation. The rest of the ~20 people are stable for now.
Ocean Viking has reached the position and is launching its RHIBs to begin the rescue of the ~101 people.

notes: Rescue operation under way, not the originating alert.

input.text: After five days at sea, the 180 survivors on board Geo Barents have finally been assigned Bari as a place of safety.
The people we were in contact with yesterday have arrived on Lampedusa and are safe in the hotspot.

notes: Follow-up: arrival ashore resolves the parent incident.

input.text: We are devastated to confirm that at least 3 people did not survive the crossing. Their bodies were recovered.
One year ago today, 27 people drowned in this stretch of sea while Europe watched. We will not forget them.

notes: Anniversary / memorial referencing a past event -> not a new active incident.

input.text: A group is stuck near the Evros river at the land border with no water and no shelter, temperatures dropping.

notes: Land border case -> humanitarian record, never a maritime marker / drift.

input.text: Still in contact with the boat. The people are exhausted but the situation is stable. We keep pushing the authorities.

notes: Thread continuation with no new operational fact.

input.text: SOS MEDITERRANEE publishes its 2025 annual report: 42,000 people rescued since 2016. Read it on our website.

notes: HARD NEGATIVE: an org publication is not a distress event.

input.text: Our ship needs you. Donate today so we can keep saving lives in the deadliest sea in the world.
